description_en: Queries the access policy of a specified secret in a KMS instance
description_zh: 查询指定凭据的凭据策略
name: GetSecretPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The name or Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the credential.

If you access a credential that belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, you must specify the ARN of the credential. The ARN of a credential must be in the `acs:kms:${region}:${account}:secret/${secret-name}` format
parameters.help_zh:
凭据名称或凭据资源名称（ARN）。
访问其他阿里云账号下的凭据时，必须输入凭据ARN。凭据ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:secret/${secret-name}`
parameters.name: secret_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the credential policy. Only the static field default is supported
parameters.help_zh: 凭据策略名称。仅支持固定值default
parameters.name: policy_name

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
